text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of the Oka Sho. Strangely enough, I'm not scared at all…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Trainer. I'll show you what I look like in full bloom on the track today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And when I come back… there's something I'd like to talk to you about.
